decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location Plan001. Existing Block Plan002. Proposed Block Plan003. Existing Boundary Wall Floor Plan004. Proposed Boundary Wall Floor Plan005. Existing Southern Elevation (from street)006. Existing Southern Section (from street)007. Existing Eastern Elevation (from side alleyway)008. Existing Eastern Section (from side alleyway)009. Existing Northern Elevation (from back alleyway)010. Existing Northern Section (from back alleyway)011. Existing Western Elevation (from side neighbour)012. Existing Western Section (from side neighbour)013. Proposed Southern Elevation (from street)014. Proposed Southern Section (from street)015. Proposed Eastern Elevation (from side alleyway)016. Proposed Eastern Section (from side alleyway)017. Proposed Northern Elevation (from back alleyway)018. Proposed Northern Section (from back alleyway)019. Proposed Western Elevation (from side neighbour) 020. Proposed Western Section (from side neighbour)Site PhotographReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

Prior to the completion of the boundary wall hereby approved, details of the proposed landscaping associated with the boundary treatment, including planting species, planting density, and details of implementation and maintenance, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.The approved landscaping shall thereafter be implemented during the first planting season following completion of the boundary wall and permanently retained thereafter.Any trees, shrubs or plants which die, are removed, become severely damaged or diseased within a period of five years from the date of planting shall be replaced in the next planting season with others of similar size and species.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance, to soften the visual impact of the boundary treatment, and to preserve the character and appearance of the surrounding area.
description: Erection of front, side and rear boundary wall to a maximum height of 2.4m
